rule: All experiment code is written and run ONLY after FREEZE_V1.json exists; tiny worlds are exhausted before any large array; adaptive exploratory results are never headline claims.
placement_default: CPU branchy-exact (LUNARC lu + laptop billy + billy-old); A40 only for measured batched dense work

worlds.name: obligation hypergraphs
worlds.notes: parsing/proof/planning-isomorphic finite deduction hypergraphs; seeds for exhaustive semiring cross-checks

worlds.name: round-trip semantics
worlds.notes: I/R/J relation triples with controlled coverage gaps; omitted-reading hostile

worlds.name: provenance/support
worlds.notes: support hypergraphs with alternative supports + controlled negative dependencies

worlds.name: abstraction/refinement
worlds.notes: concrete worlds with deliberately lossy partitions; spurious counterexample injection

worlds.name: reduction/equality
worlds.notes: arithmetic/algebra/program-expression families with independently checked semantics; unsound-rewrite hostile

worlds.name: planning hierarchy
worlds.notes: flat STRIPS / reductions / HTN / POMDP / options phase-map families

worlds.name: cross-domain same-hypergraph
worlds.notes: same abstract derivation object, different domain semantics/checkers

experiments.name: machine-check elementary tranche
experiments.deliverable: per-row proof artifact + executable finite oracle + smallest hostile per removed assumption
experiments.primary_endpoint: oracle green on all frozen tiny worlds; hostile arms flip exactly when the named assumption is removed; P2 certificates never re-labeled P1

experiments.name: obligation-hypergraph semiring engine
experiments.deliverable: one finite hypergraph engine, swappable evaluators: Boolean reachability, counting, Viterbi, min-plus tropical, provenance N[X], packed derivation forest; brute-force cross-check on tiny worlds
experiments.evidence_class: CONFIRMATORY_FIXED (cross-check) + EXPLORATORY_ADAPTIVE (when packed reuse beats re-solving)
experiments.primary_endpoint: exact evaluator agreement vs brute-force enumeration = 1.0 on all tiny worlds; measured packed-reuse win regions; SCC/cycle licence violations detected and reported

experiments.name: provenance + revocation worlds
experiments.deliverable: substitution-vs-recomputation agreement; single/multiple revocations; alternate-support preservation; planted missing-edge hostile; positive vs negation-aware provenance
experiments.primary_endpoint: exact agreement of accepted/reopened obligations after revocation; secondary: touched-state and lifecycle burden

experiments.name: abstraction/refinement/CEGAR worlds
experiments.deliverable: direct concrete search vs fixed abstraction vs adaptive refinement vs hostile non-strict refinement
experiments.primary_endpoint: refinement count <= n-k ceiling always; states distinguished; search saved/added; verification cost; false abstraction certificates retained

experiments.name: reduction + equality-saturation worlds
experiments.deliverable: direct solve vs one-shot rewrite vs ordered rewriting vs Knuth-Bendix vs equality saturation+extraction vs learned reduction library; unsound-rewrite hostile arm
experiments.primary_endpoint: semantic protection catches 100% of planted unsound-rewrite contamination; present-cost and future-reuse tracked separately per T87

experiments.name: heterogeneous-logic transport
experiments.deliverable: finite exhaustive satisfaction-condition tests; consequence preservation; model-expansiveness; hostile incomplete model images
experiments.primary_endpoint: T85 preservation/reflection verified on every enumerated pair; hostile reduct-image failure reproduced exactly; N4 stays locked

experiments.name: language semantic round-trip laboratory
experiments.deliverable: synthetic/frozen semantic tuples with protected coordinates (referent/negation/quantity/scope/modality/uncertainty/speech-act); paraphrase + ambiguous/costume outputs
experiments.evidence_class: EXPLORATORY_ADAPTIVE then CONFIRMATORY_FIXED on frozen tuple sets
experiments.primary_endpoint: I/R/J coverage (not accuracy alone); protected round-trip error; ambiguity-set size; clarification value; abstention; B_exec vector; N2 LOCKED - synthetic only

experiments.name: math/proof laboratory
experiments.deliverable: proof DAGs; lemma reuse; proof-neutral sets; SMT fragments; rewrite/e-graph algebra; proof-carrying candidate admission
experiments.primary_endpoint: admission only via checker+policy binding (P83 hostile); N4 LOCKED - legal fixtures + synthetic finite theorem worlds only

experiments.name: general problem-solving laboratory
experiments.deliverable: matched finite worlds: flat STRIPS / verified reductions / HTN / POMDP belief planning / options; search phase diagrams
experiments.primary_endpoint: representation win/lose regions after complete lifecycle cost; hierarchy-negative regions retained explicitly; N5 LOCKED - laboratory not adoption

experiments.name: cross-domain operator-transfer test
experiments.deliverable: same abstract operator contract (DISTINGUISH/REFINE/REDUCE/VERIFY) instantiated in >=3 materially different domains with different checkers
experiments.primary_endpoint: transfer of the invariant contract (not the name): same contract law holds + measured B_exec delta per domain; negative transfer retained

experiments.name: developmental semantic execution
experiments.deliverable: CONTINUED vs RESET vs strongest persistent parent across fresh problem-family sequences
experiments.evidence_class: EXPLORATORY_ADAPTIVE then CONFIRMATORY_ANYTIME_VALID for any headline burden-reduction claim
experiments.placement: CPU + A40 only if measured batched need appears
experiments.primary_endpoint: B_exec vector + first-useful-solution hitting burden + new-information required + counterexamples required + verification calls + active k/N; correctness/coverage/negative-transfer gates hold

experiments.name: fresh-context hostile review + downstream integration
experiments.deliverable: independent reviewer replays theorem proofs/certificates, parent claims, freeze chain, negatives, coverage; then scoped hooks to #93/#43/#44/#46/#47/#217/#221
experiments.primary_endpoint: review verdict PASS/PASS_WITH_FINDINGS/FAIL; hooks only AFTER review; no locked milestone criterion changed retroactively
